mapper.select: SELECT playlist_id AS playlistId, album_id AS albumId, music_id AS musicId, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM playlist ORDER BY playlist_id DESC

SELECT playlist_id AS playlistId, album_id AS albumId, music_id AS musicId, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM playlist WHERE playlist_id = #{playlistId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO playlist ( album_id, music_id, start_time, end_time ) VALUES ( #{albumId}, #{musicId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE playlist SET album_id = #{albumId}, music_id = #{musicId}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE playlist_id = #{playlistId}
